fixes_after_review: B1: /api/v1/setup accepted only from loopback (test_12b binds 0.0.0.0 and calls from the LAN address -> AUTH-FORBIDDEN)
B2: one request_id per run form, kept until a definitive answer; submit disabled while pending
TLS handshake moved to the connection thread with a 30 s timeout (accept() no longer blockable)
lease sweep also on list/get jobs (offline/revoked station jobs become uncertain)
agent: single-flight outbox flush; tick survives unexpected exceptions
Core errors return the caller's X-Correlation-Id; invalid UUIDs -> 400 VALIDATION
concurrent identical request_id answers with the existing job; last-admin check locks all admin rows
diagnostic validate rejects unknown fields and non-object version/technical_details/boundary
long Tauri commands async; record_compile canonicalizes paths; native alert/prompt/confirm replaced by in-app UI
